targets.expr:
count(
  label_replace(
    diskSMARTAttrStatus{diskSMARTAttrStatus!="OK"}
      * on(instance, job, diskSMARTInfoIndex) group_left(diskSMARTInfoDevName)
      diskSMARTInfoDevName,
    "storageIODevice", "$1", "diskSMARTInfoDevName", ".*/([^/]+)$"
  )
) by (storageIODevice)
or
count(
  label_replace(
    diskSMARTAttrStatus
      * on(instance, job, diskSMARTInfoIndex) group_left(diskSMARTInfoDevName)
      diskSMARTInfoDevName,
    "storageIODevice", "$1", "diskSMARTInfoDevName", ".*/([^/]+)$"
  )
) by (storageIODevice) * 0
